statement: Let cnt(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = v} for each integer v. Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists an integer x with x > 1 such that x divides cnt(v) for every value v that occurs in deck. Equivalently, r = true iff the greatest common divisor of the positive numbers cnt(v), over all values v that occur in deck, is greater than 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(deck), 0 <= deck[i] < 10000.

statement: For every deck satisfying the preconditions, has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r; that is, the function does not fail.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(deck), 0 <= deck[i] < 10000.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r, r = false.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000; 0 <= deck[i] < 10000 for all i; and there exist two distinct integer values a and b that each occur in deck such that gcd(cnt(a), cnt(b)) = 1, where cnt(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = v}.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r and r = true, for every value v that occurs in deck, cnt(v) >= 2, where cnt(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = v}.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(deck), 0 <= deck[i] < 10000.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r, r = true.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000; 0 <= deck[i] < 10000 for all i; and for every value v that occurs in deck, cnt(v) is even, where cnt(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = v}.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r, r = true if and only if gcd(m, n) > 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000; 0 <= deck[i] < 10000 for all i; and exactly two distinct integer values a and b occur in deck. Let m = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = a} and n = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = b}.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck1) returns a result r1 and has_groups_size_x(deck2) returns a result r2, r1 = r2.
preconditions: deck1 and deck2 are two slices each satisfying 1 <= len <= 10000 and having all elements in [0, 10000). For every integer v, cnt1(v) = cnt2(v), where cnt1(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck1) and deck1[j] = v} and cnt2(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck2) and deck2[j] = v}.

statement: Whenever has_groups_size_x(deck) returns a result r and r = true, there exists an integer x such that 2 <= x <= min { cnt(v) | v occurs in deck } and x divides cnt(v) for every value v that occurs in deck, where cnt(v) = #{j | 0 <= j < len(deck) and deck[j] = v}.
preconditions: 1 <= len(deck) <= 10000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(deck), 0 <= deck[i] < 10000.
